general.title: MOSuite - Plot Volcano Summary
general.instructions: Create summary volcano plots for each tested contrast in differential expression analysis results

parameters.name: Significance column name
parameters.description: Character vector of full significance column names, one per contrast (e.g. c("B-A_adjpval", "C-A_adjpval")). Leave blank to auto-detect corresponding columns by checking for _adjpval first, then _pval, for each contrast in change_colname.

parameters.name: Significance threshold
parameters.description: Numeric significance threshold used as the p-value or adjusted p-value cutoff. Default: 0.05.

parameters.name: Fold change column name
parameters.description: Character vector of full logFC column names, one per contrast (e.g. c("B-A_logFC", "C-A_logFC")). Leave blank to auto-detect all columns ending in _logFC.

parameters.name: Fold change threshold
parameters.description: Numeric fold-change cutoff used with change_colname to classify features by fold-change significance.

parameters.name: Label only custom features
parameters.description: Select TRUE to label only the specific list of features provided in custom_gene_list. Leave FALSE to add custom_gene_list labels to the automatically selected top features.

parameters.name: Custom gene/feature list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of features to label on the volcano plot. By default, these labels are added to the automatically selected top features; turn on Label only custom features to label only this list.

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: Column containing feature identifiers, such as gene or protein IDs. If left blank, MOSuite uses the first column of the differential-results table.

parameters.name: Sort output by
parameters.description: How to sort the output dataset and choose top labels. Options are fold-change, p-value, or t-statistic.

parameters.name: Flip volcano plot
parameters.description: Set TRUE to flip the fold-change values so the volcano plot looks like the comparison was reversed. Default: FALSE.

parameters.name: Additional DEG columns
parameters.description: Additional columns from the DEG analysis to include in the output dataset. Default: FC, logFC, tstat, pval, adjpval.

parameters.name: Point size
parameters.description: Size of the points in the plot.

parameters.name: Non-significant feature color
parameters.description: Color of non-significant features. Default: grey30.

parameters.name: Color for significance only
parameters.description: Color of features that meet only the significance threshold. Default: royalblue.

parameters.name: Color for both thresholds
parameters.description: Color of features that meet both the p-value and fold-change thresholds. Default: red2.

parameters.name: Significance threshold line color
parameters.description: Color of the significance threshold line. Default: black.

parameters.name: Fold change threshold line color
parameters.description: Color of the log fold-change threshold line. Default: forestgreen.

parameters.name: Plot title
parameters.description: Title of the plot. Default: Volcano Plots.

parameters.name: Title font size
parameters.description: Size of the plot title. Default: 24.

parameters.name: Use custom axis labels
parameters.description: If TRUE, use custom labels for the plot axes, set by Significance label and Fold change label.

parameters.name: Fold change label
parameters.description: Name for the fold-change column in the plot. Default is log2FC.

parameters.name: Significance label
parameters.description: Name for the significance column in the plot. Default is p-value.

parameters.name: Axis tick label size
parameters.description: Size of the axis tick labels. Default: 16.

parameters.name: Axis label size
parameters.description: Size of the axis labels. Default: 24.

parameters.name: Use default X-axis limit
parameters.description: Set TRUE to use the default x-axis limit. Default: TRUE.

parameters.name: Custom X-axis limit
parameters.description: Custom x-axis limit used when Use default X-axis limit is FALSE. Default: c(-5, 5).

parameters.name: Use default Y-axis limit
parameters.description: Set TRUE to use the default y-axis limit. Default: TRUE.

parameters.name: Custom Y-axis limit
parameters.description: Custom y-axis limit used when Use default Y-axis limit is FALSE. Default: c(0, 10).

parameters.name: Number of features to label
parameters.description: Number of top features or genes to label in the volcano plot.

parameters.name: Default label color
parameters.description: Color for text used to add feature or gene name labels to points.

parameters.name: Custom label color
parameters.description: Color for the specific list of features provided in the custom gene/feature list parameter.

parameters.name: Label significant features only
parameters.description: If TRUE, automatic labels are selected only from features that pass both the significance and fold-change thresholds.

parameters.name: Draw label connector lines
parameters.description: If TRUE, draw connector lines from labels to their points and spread labels to reduce overlap.

parameters.name: Label font size
parameters.description: Font size of the labels. Default: 5.

parameters.name: Image width
parameters.description: Output image width for the saved volcano summary plot.

parameters.name: DPI
parameters.description: Dots per inch of the output image.

parameters.name: Plot filename
parameters.description: Filename for the output plot. Default: volcano_plot.png in the MOSuite function documentation.

parameters.name: Image height
parameters.description: Output image height for the saved volcano summary plot.

parameters.name: Use default grid layout
parameters.description: Set TRUE to use the default grid layout. Default: TRUE.

parameters.name: Number of rows in grid
parameters.description: Number of rows in the grid layout. Default: 1.
